result.brief: 提出 SpecWM：以目标相似度核显式指定观测关系，训练 JEPA 编码器在嵌入几何中复现该关系，并分析最优解与线性可恢复性，提升潜世界模型的可控表征质量。
result.reason: Introduces SpecWM, a JEPA spectral representation learning framework specifying embedding geometry via target similarity kernels, with theory on recoverability; directly a visual/world-model representation contribution.
